allowed_bases.THIRD_PARTY_PROFILE: A profile or entry the entity controls on a host it does not own (a social profile, Wikidata, Crunchbase). source_url must be off the entity host and must name the entity, so a profile cannot be claimed on resemblance alone.

why_no_third_party_record: Superseded 31 October 2026: there is now a THIRD_PARTY_PROFILE record - the entity's public source repository, github.com/seq23/local-guides-citation-velocity, which resolves 200 and names the entity host. The social handles stay unclaimed, and that history is kept here because it says what was checked and found dead: on 26 October 2026 pinterest.com/theindustryguides and linkedin.com/company/theindustryguides did not exist (Pinterest answers 200 for any handle, so the body was compared against a known-live account and a deliberately bogus one; the bogus handle and theindustryguides both returned the "user not found" body), crunchbase.com refused robots, and x.com/industryguides resolves but is someone else's account and is NOT claimed. Re-checked 30 October 2026: linkedin.com/company/theindustryguides and /the-industry-guides 404, youtube.com/@theindustryguides 404, github.com/theindustryguides 404 (the organisation account - the repository above was not looked at), facebook.com/theindustryguides 400, theindustryguides.substack.com 404, Bluesky theindustryguides.com "Profile not found", no Wikidata entity.
